# DiscoveryPanel

A bordered panel that scans for something on the network and shows what it finds.

## Anatomy

A header — mono title, prose description, and the scan action — over a hairline rule, then the body, which shows a `Spinner` while scanning and its children otherwise.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` | — | The mono heading — "Broadlink devices". |
| `description` | `string` | `''` | The prose line under it, set in the reference's serif italic. |
| `scanLabel` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `scanning` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `scanningLabel` | `string` | `'Scanning'` | Announced while a scan runs, and shown beside the spinner. |
| `onscan` | `() => void` | — | — |
| `children` | `Snippet` | — | — |

## Variants

None.

## States

Idle, scanning, populated, empty.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Reaches the scan action, then the body. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Starts a scan. |

## ARIA

The scan action is disabled while a scan runs; the `Spinner`'s status region announces that it is running, so the wait is never silent.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
